For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, sexual sins, thefts, false testimony, and blasphemies.
For from within, out of the hearts of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, sexual sins, murders, thefts,
covetings, wickedness, deceit, lustful desires, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, and foolishness.
But sin, finding occasion through the commandment, produced in me all kinds of coveting. For apart from the law, sin is…
I was alive apart from the law once, but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.
Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously”?

crossRefs.note: In his day you shall give him his wages, neither shall the sun go down on it; for he is poor and sets his heart on it…
Yahweh said, “I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their cry because of…
If you take advantage of them at all, and they cry at all to me, I will surely hear their cry;
so that they caused the cry of the poor to come to him. He heard the cry of the afflicted.
For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.
Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor, he will also cry out, but shall not be heard.
Behold, the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you have kept back by fraud, cry out, and the cries of…
Then he will say also to those on the left hand, ‘Depart from me, you cursed, into the eternal fire which is prepared…
To him therefore who knows to do good, and doesn’t do it, to him it is sin.
Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.

translations.web: Beware that there not be a wicked thought in your heart, saying, “The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand,” and your eye be evil against your poor brother and you give him nothing; and he cry to Yahweh against you, and it be sin to you.
translations.bsb: Be careful not to harbor this wicked thought in your heart: “The seventh year, the year of release, is near,” so that you look upon your poor brother begrudgingly and give him nothing. He will cry out to the LORD against you, and you will be guilty of sin.
translations.kjv: Beware that there be not a thought in thy wicked heart, saying, The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand; and thine eye be evil against thy poor brother, and thou givest him nought; and he cry unto the LORD against thee, and it be sin
translations.asv: Beware that there be not a base thought in thy heart, saying, The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand; and thine eye be evil against thy poor brother, and thou give him nought; and he cry unto Jehovah against thee, and it be sin unto thee.
